links.outcome: Readability of LLM pre-anesthetic patient education responses (Flesch-Kincaid grade, Flesch Reading Ease)
links.effect: Gemini text was more readable than ChatGPT (lower Flesch-Kincaid Grade level p = 0.04; higher Flesch Reading Ease p = 0.04); ChatGPT was less readable.
links.quote: Gemini generated text with greater readability, demonstrated by a lower Flesch-Kincaid Grade level (p = 0.04) and higher Flesch Reading Ease score (p = 0.04).

unlisted_practices: Head-to-head comparison of LLMs for pre-anesthetic patient education content quality, with sentiment analysis of responses

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the performance (accuracy, safety, readability, sentiment) of ChatGPT and Google Gemini for pre-anesthetic patient education questions, assessed offline by 20 anesthesiologists.
